units.source_text: 他身穿平日惯穿的衣服，上面只加一件便袍，此时拿起琵琶来弹奏。

en.t: He wore the clothes he usually wore, with only a casual robe added over them, and now picked up the biwa and began to play.

units.source_text: 他把琵琶合着黄钟调，弹出非常哀愁的曲子。

en.t: He tuned the biwa to the huangzhong mode and played an exceptionally sorrowful piece.

units.source_text: 二女公子原是喜爱音乐之人，听了这琵琶之声，心中怨恨顿时消释，

en.t: The two young ladies had always loved music, and when they heard the sound of the biwa, the resentment in their hearts at once melted away,

units.source_text: 把身子靠在矮几上，从小帷屏旁边稍稍探出头来，那姿态非常可爱。

en.t: and as they leaned against a low table and peeped out slightly from beside the small screen, their manner was very charming.
